data.subject: Public-records research for Elizabeth Park
data.body:
Hi,

Your most recent 13F, for the period ended June 30, 2026, shows positions in PLBC, JMSB, and USCB.

On September 8, 2026, JMSB entered into a material definitive agreement, according to its Form 8-K Item 1.01 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1710482/000155278126000472/e26378_jmsb-8k.htm).

I publish Local Ledger, an independent research publisher using public records only and never issuer-paid. I can send the free weekly issue and outline a four-week fund pilot.

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.

Andrew
Founder, Local Ledger
